## Use Ubuntu Sans Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Ubuntu Sans Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Ubuntu Sans Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Ubuntu Sans Mono coding font

The monospace member of the modern Ubuntu Sans family. Ubuntu Sans Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Ubuntu Sans Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Ubuntu Sans Mono FAQ

### Is Ubuntu Sans Mono free?

Yes. Ubuntu Sans Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Ubuntu Sans Mono support ligatures?

No. Ubuntu Sans Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Ubuntu Sans Mono?

Ubuntu Sans Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
